operation: guide
jq: keys
jq error: {library,request,counts,section_outcomes,outcome,member_example: .members[0],type_example: .types[0]}

jq: {typeKeys: (.types|type),memberKeys: (.members|type), suffix: (.suffix_family_types|keys),name: (.name_word_types|keys), attrkeys: (.attribute_type_members|keys|map(select(contains("Requires"))))}

jq: {stream: .parameter_type_members["System.IO.Stream"], doc: .produced_type_members["System.Text.Json.JsonDocument"], attr: .attribute_type_members["System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.RequiresUnreferencedCodeAttribute"]}

jq: {stream: .parameter_type_members["T:System.IO.Stream"], doc: .produced_type_members["T:System.Text.Json.JsonDocument"], attr: .attribute_type_members["T:System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.RequiresUnreferencedCodeAttribute"]}
jq: {library,request,counts,section_outcomes,outcome,member_example: .members[0],type_example: (.types|to_entries|.[0])}

jq: {converter_suffix: .suffix_family_types.Converter, converter_names: .name_word_types.Converter, returnKeys: (.return_type_members|keys|map(select(contains("JsonDocument")))), producedKeys: (.produced_type_members|keys|map(select(contains("JsonDocument"))))}

jq: [. as $d | .produced_type_members["T:System.Text.Json.JsonDocument"][] as $id | $d.members[] | select(.documentation_id == $id) | {id: .documentation_id, type: .declaring_type, signature: .display_signature, produced: .produced_types, return_type: .return_type}]

jq: [.members[] | select(.attribute_types | index("T:System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.RequiresUnreferencedCodeAttribute")) | {type: .declaring_type, name, signature: .display_signature}] | group_by([.type,.name]) | map({type: .[0].type, name: .[0].name, count: length, signatures: map(.signature)})

jq: {parseasync: [.members[] | select(.declaring_type == "T:System.Text.Json.JsonDocument" and .name == "ParseAsync") | {id: .documentation_id, signature: .display_signature, documentation}], converters: [.name_word_types.Converter[] as $id | {id: $id, data: .types[$id] | {name, declaration_kind, definition_kind, accessibility, is_sealed, is_abstract, base_type, required_overrides}}]}

jq: [.members[] | select(.declaring_type == "T:System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer" and .name == "Deserialize" and any(.parameters[]; .type == "System.IO.Stream")) | {id: .documentation_id, signature: .display_signature, source}]

jq: [. as $d | .parameter_type_members["T:System.IO.Stream"][] as $id | $d.members[] | select(.documentation_id == $id) | {id: .documentation_id, type: .declaring_type, signature: .display_signature}]

jq error: [.members as $m | $m[] | select(.attribute_types | index("T:System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.RequiresUnreferencedCodeAttribute")) | {type: .declaring_type, name}] | unique | map(. as $key | $m | map(select(.declaring_type == $key.type and .name == $key.name and ((.attribute_types | index("T:System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.RequiresUnreferencedCodeAttribute")) | not))) as $plain | $key + {unmarked_count: ($plain | length), unmarked_signatures: ($plain | map(.display_signature))})
jq: [.members[] | select(.declaring_type == "T:System.Text.Json.JsonDocument" and .name == "ParseAsync") | {accessibility,is_static,signature: .display_signature,documentation}]
jq: [.name_word_types.Converter[] as $id | {type: $id, constructors: [.members[] | select(.declaring_type == $id and .name == "#ctor") | {signature: .display_signature, accessibility}]}]

jq: [.members[] | select(.declaring_type | contains("System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter")) | select(.name == "#ctor" or .name == "CanConvert" or .name == "Type" or .name == "Read" or .name == "Write" or .name == "CreateConverter") | {id: .documentation_id, signature: .display_signature, accessibility, is_abstract, is_virtual, is_override}]

jq: .members as $m | ([$m[] | select(.attribute_types | index("T:System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.RequiresUnreferencedCodeAttribute")) | {type: .declaring_type, name}] | unique) | map(. as $key | ([$m[] | select(.declaring_type == $key.type and .name == $key.name and ((.attribute_types | index("T:System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.RequiresUnreferencedCodeAttribute")) | not)) | .display_signature]) as $plain | $key + {unmarked_count: ($plain | length), unmarked_examples: $plain[:3]})

jq: {converter_types: [.name_word_types.Converter[] as $id | {id: $id, summary: .types[$id].documentation.summary, required_overrides: .types[$id].required_overrides}], attribute_create: [.members[] | select(.documentation_id == "M:System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverterAttribute.CreateConverter(System.Type)") | {signature: .display_signature, documentation}]}
jq: .attribute_type_members["T:System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.RequiresUnreferencedCodeAttribute"] | length
